senses.title: The overall plan of an experiment
senses.definition: the complete arrangement of conditions, treatments and observations before data are collected
senses.definitionCN: 在收集数据之前对条件、处理与观测的完整安排
senses.example: A clear experimental design prevents wasted effort.
senses.exampleCN: 清楚的实验设计能避免白费力气。
senses.why: Design is a plan drawn in advance, and an experiment without one simply accumulates numbers.
senses.whyCN: 设计是事先画好的图，没有图的实验只是在堆积数字。

senses.title: Assignment of treatments and controls
senses.definition: the rule by which some units receive the treatment and others serve as comparison
senses.definitionCN: 规定哪些单位接受处理、哪些作为比较的规则
senses.example: The experimental design assigned half the plots to the new seed.
senses.exampleCN: 该实验设计把一半地块分给新种子。
senses.why: Comparison is the heart of an experiment, so assignment is the first thing the design must settle.
senses.whyCN: 比较是实验的核心，因此分配是设计首先要定下的事。

senses.title: Randomisation and replication
senses.definition: the structure that spreads chance evenly and repeats conditions enough to estimate error
senses.definitionCN: 把偶然均匀铺开、并重复条件以估计误差的结构
senses.example: Randomisation and replication are the backbone of the experimental design.
senses.exampleCN: 随机化与重复是实验设计的骨架。
senses.why: Chance and repetition do the work that intuition cannot: they make an effect visible against noise.
senses.whyCN: 偶然与重复做直觉做不到的事：让效应在噪声中显形。

senses.title: A between-subjects design
senses.definition: a plan in which different participants receive different conditions
senses.definitionCN: 不同参与者接受不同条件的方案
senses.example: The experimental design compared two separate groups.
senses.exampleCN: 该实验设计比较了两个独立的组。
senses.why: Separating people avoids practice effects but requires more participants, a real design trade-off.
senses.whyCN: 把人分开可避免练习效应，却需要更多参与者，这是实打实的设计权衡。

senses.title: A within-subjects design
senses.definition: a plan in which the same participants experience every condition
senses.definitionCN: 同一批参与者经历所有条件的方案
senses.example: A within-subjects experimental design reduces the number of volunteers needed.
senses.exampleCN: 组内实验设计减少了所需志愿者的数量。
senses.why: Using each person as their own comparison removes individual differences but invites order effects.
senses.whyCN: 让每个人做自己的比较能去掉个体差异，却会招来顺序效应。

senses.title: A factorial design
senses.definition: a plan that crosses two or more factors so that their separate and joint effects can be estimated
senses.definitionCN: 把两个或更多因素交叉组合，以估计各自与联合效应的方案
senses.example: The factorial experimental design crossed temperature with dose.
senses.exampleCN: 这个析因实验设计把温度与剂量交叉起来。
senses.why: Crossing factors turns a single study into several comparisons at once, which is why the design matters.
senses.whyCN: 交叉因素把一项研究同时变成几组比较，这正是设计的重要性。

senses.title: The protocol and its documentation
senses.definition: the written record of procedures, materials and decision rules that allows the study to be repeated
senses.definitionCN: 记录程序、材料与决策规则、使研究可被重复的书面文件
senses.example: The experimental design was registered before the first participant arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 实验设计在第一位参与者到来之前就已登记。
senses.why: A design that cannot be written down cannot be repeated, and an unrepeatable experiment is a story.
senses.whyCN: 写不下来的设计无法被重复，而不可重复的实验只是一个故事。

senses.title: A design chosen to avoid bias
senses.titleCN: 为避免偏差而选的设计
senses.definition: a plan whose structure removes known sources of systematic error such as selection or order effects
senses.definitionCN: 其结构能消除选择偏差、顺序效应等已知系统误差来源的方案
senses.example: Blinding was built into the experimental design to prevent bias.
senses.exampleCN: 实验设计中内置了盲法以防止偏差。
senses.why: Bias is a property of plans rather than of people, so it must be designed out in advance.
senses.whyCN: 偏差是方案的性质而非人的性质，因此必须在事先设计掉。

intro.en: Experimental design joins a Latin word for trial with a Latin verb for marking out. The trial supplies the testing, and the marking supplies the plan drawn before anything is done.
intro.cn: 这个词组把拉丁语中表示「尝试」的词，与表示「标出」的动词接在一起：尝试提供检验，标出提供动手之前画好的图。

items.en: Periri meant to try or attempt, and with the prefix for out it produced experiri, to test thoroughly.
items.cn: 这个词根意为「尝试」，加上表示「向外」的前缀后构成「彻底试」。

items.en: The noun named a trial or test, and English experiment came through French with the same core.
items.cn: 这个名词指试验或检验，英语的「实验」经法语而来，核心义相同。

items.en: The adjective appeared with the rise of natural philosophy, where knowledge was to be tested rather than argued.
items.cn: 这个形容词随自然哲学的兴起而出现，当时知识要靠检验而非论辩。

items.en: Signum meant a mark or sign, and designare meant to mark out and hence to plan.
items.cn: 这个词根意为「标记」，其动词意为标出，因而指规划。

items.en: Design entered through French and Italian for a plan or a drawing, before it meant the arrangement of a study.
items.cn: 这个词经法语与意大利语进入英语，先指平面图或图样，后指研究的安排。

items.en: Statistical texts fixed experimental design as the branch that plans comparisons; the exact first record of the phrase is uncertain.
items.cn: 统计学教材把「实验设计」固定为规划比较的分支；该短语确切最早记录不确定。

note.en: The first group belongs to the experiment family; the second group names neighbouring plans and methods.
note.cn: 第一组属于「实验」同族；第二组指相邻的规划与方法。

entries.definition: A test carried out to see what happens under stated conditions.
entries.definitionCN: 指在规定条件下进行、观察结果的检验。

entries.definition: Relating to or based on experiments.
entries.definitionCN: 指与实验有关的或以实验为基础的。

entries.definition: By means of an experiment.
entries.definitionCN: 指以实验方式。

entries.definition: The activity of running experiments.
entries.definitionCN: 指从事实验的活动。

entries.definition: The person who runs an experiment.
entries.definitionCN: 指做实验的人。

entries.definition: A plan or pattern made in advance.
entries.definitionCN: 指事先制定的方案或图样。

entries.definition: The broader plan of a study, including sampling and measurement.
entries.definitionCN: 指更宽的研究规划，含抽样与测量。

entries.definition: The written procedure that the design is turned into.
entries.definitionCN: 指设计转化成的书面程序。

entries.definition: The principles behind the choice of methods, broader than one design.
entries.definitionCN: 指方法选择背后的原则，比单个设计更宽。

entries.definition: A plan with comparison groups but without random assignment.
entries.definitionCN: 指有对照组但无随机分配的方案。

entries.definition: The rule for choosing which units enter the study.
entries.definitionCN: 指选择哪些单位进入研究的规则。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the plot map, randomisation and replication, and the trade-offs between designs.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用地块平面图、随机化与重复，以及不同设计之间的权衡。

normal.en: Design is a mark made in advance, so experimental design is the map drawn before the first measurement.
normal.cn: 设计是事先做的标记，所以实验设计是第一次测量之前画好的图。

normal.en: The fixed textbook phrase is «experimental design and analysis», pairing the plan with its statistics.
normal.cn: 教材里的固定说法是「实验设计与分析」，把规划与统计配在一起。

normal.en: Between-subjects needs more people; within-subjects needs fewer but risks order effects.
normal.cn: 组间设计需要更多人，组内设计需要人少却有顺序效应之险。

normal.en: Randomisation and replication are the two pillars under every sound experimental design.
normal.cn: 随机化与重复是每个可靠实验设计下的两根柱子。

normal.en: Blinding is designed in, because bias belongs to the plan and not to the person.
normal.cn: 盲法是设计进去的，因为偏差属于方案而不属于个人。

abstract.en: A design is the argument made before the data can speak.
abstract.cn: 设计是数据开口之前就已作出的论证。

abstract.en: An experiment without a plan is only a busy room.
abstract.cn: 没有方案的实验只是一间忙碌的屋子。

abstract.en: The strongest designs make it possible to be wrong, and that possibility is what makes them trustworthy.
abstract.cn: 最强的设计让「被证明错了」成为可能，正是这种可能使它可信。

examples.en: The experimental design used four groups with two crossed factors.
examples.cn: 该实验设计使用了四个组与两个交叉因素。

examples.en: Flaws in the experimental design made the results impossible to interpret.
examples.cn: 实验设计的缺陷使结果无法解释。

examples.en: She revised the experimental design after the pilot study.
examples.cn: 预试验之后她修改了实验设计。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「实验」是去试，「设计」是先画：试之前把地块、处理与对照都画在图上，就是实验设计

root: 「实验」来自拉丁语 experimentum「试验」，其动词 experiri 意为「彻底试」，由 ex-「向外」与表示「尝试」的词根构成；「设计」来自拉丁语 designare「标出」，由 de- 与 signum「标记」构成。统计学教材把「实验设计」固定为规划比较的分支；该短语最早记录不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses run from the whole plan to its safeguards: the overall arrangement, treatment assignment, randomisation and replication, between-subjects, within-subjects, factorial crossing, written protocol, and bias prevention.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从整体规划延伸到防偏措施：总体安排、处理分配、随机化与重复、组间设计、组内设计、析因交叉、书面方案、防偏设计。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a field is marked into plots on paper, with treated rows and a control row laid out before planting.
core.cn: 核心意象：田地在纸上被划成小区，处理行与对照行在播种之前就已排好。

branches.en: THE DRAWN PLAN: the complete arrangement, its written protocol and its repeatability.
branches.cn: 画好的图：完整安排、书面方案与可重复性。

branches.en: THE ASSIGNMENT RULE: who receives the treatment and who serves as comparison.
branches.cn: 分配规则：谁接受处理，谁作为比较。

branches.en: THE TWO PILLARS: chance spread evenly and conditions repeated.
branches.cn: 两根柱子：偶然被均匀铺开，条件被重复。

branches.en: THE TWO COMPARISONS: different people across groups, or the same people across conditions.
branches.cn: 两种比较：不同人跨组，或同一人跨条件。

branches.en: THE CROSSED AND GUARDED: factors crossed to reveal joint effects, and structure built against bias.
branches.cn: 交叉与防护：交叉因素显出联合效应，结构用来抵御偏差。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin trial word to a Latin marking word, so an experiment is a test and a design is a plan drawn beforehand.
intro.cn: 这个词组把拉丁语的「尝试」与「标记」接起来：实验是检验，设计是事先画好的图。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「彻底试」与「标出」；该复合词的统计义属现代用法，最早记录不确定。
